Title: Food insecurity
Label: Food insecurity
Subtitle: Percent of adults 18+ at risk of food insecurity
AgeAdjustment: Yes, to the US 2000 standard population
MethodsNote: Respondents reported that in the last 12 months they often or sometimes either (1) worry that food would run out before their household got money to buy more or (2) food the household bought didn’t last and there was no money to buy more.
